```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>"
)
```

```{r setup}
library(SimPlot)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r simulate_data}
# data set 1: linear
sim_data1 = data.frame(x = rnorm(n = 50, 0, 1)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(y = 2*x + rnorm(n = 50, 0, 1))

# data set 2: log-linear
sim_data2 = data.frame(x = rnorm(n = 50, 0, 1)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(y = exp(1*x + rnorm(n = 50, 0, 1)))

# data set 3: quadratic
sim_data3 = data.frame(x = rnorm(n = 50, 0, 1)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(y = 2*(x-0)^2 + rnorm(n = 50, 0, 1))

# data set 4: actually binomial
sim_data4 = data.frame(x = rnorm(n = 50, 0, 1)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(y = rbinom(50, size = 8, prob = plogis(3*x)))

# data set 5: groups
sim_data5 = data.frame(x = rep(c("a", "b", "c"), each = 20)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(y = 3*(x == "a") + rnorm(n = 60, 0, 1))

# data set 6: actually ordinal
sim_data6 = data.frame(x = rnorm(n = 50, 0, 1)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(ystar = 2*x + rnorm(n = 50, 0, 1)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(y = dplyr::case_when(ystar < -2 ~ 1,
                                     -2 <= ystar & ystar < -1 ~ 2,
                                     -1 <= ystar & ystar < 0 ~ 3,
                                     0 <= ystar ~ 4))
```

```{r fit_linear_models}
m1 = lm(y ~ x, data = sim_data1)
m2 = lm(y ~ x, data = sim_data2)
m3 = lm(y ~ x, data = sim_data3)
m4 = lm(y ~ x, data = sim_data4)
m5 = lm(y ~ x, data = sim_data5)
m6 = lm(y ~ x, data = sim_data6)
```

```{r marginal_distributions}
sim_plot(m1)
sim_plot(m2)
sim_plot(m3)
sim_plot(m4)
sim_plot(m5)
sim_plot(m6)
```

```{r scatterplots}
sim_plot(m1, predictor = "x")
sim_plot(m2, predictor = "x")
sim_plot(m3, predictor = "x")
sim_plot(m4, predictor = "x")
sim_plot(m5, predictor = "x")
sim_plot(m6, predictor = "x")
```
